[[File:Political map of the world, April 1989. LOC 2010585495.jpg|thumb|right|400px|Map of countries in 1989]]
This is a '''list of countries by population in 1989''', providing an overview of the world population before the [[Revolutions of 1989|fall of the Iron Curtain]].

While the population data<ref name="aktuell">{{cite book |title=Aktuell '91 – Das Lexikon der Gegenwart, Harenberg Lexikon Verlag (1990) |isbn=3611001309 |last1=Jahrgang |first1=Siebter |year=1990 |publisher=Harenberg Lexikon-Verlag }}</ref> is almost exclusively dated 1989, political developments before the summer of 1990 are taken into account, including [[Yemeni unification]] and [[Namibian War of Independence|Namibian independence]] but not [[German reunification]] which was finalised only in October, the [[breakup of Yugoslavia]] and [[dissolution of the Soviet Union]] took place two years later, and the [[dissolution of Czechoslovakia]] three years later.

The numbers given in ''Aktuell '91''<ref name="aktuell" /> are fully compatible with the data given by the U.S. Census Bureau,<ref>https://www.census.gov/population/international/data/idb/region.php?N=%20Results%20&T=13&A=separate&RT=0&Y=1989&R=1&C=AF {{dead link|date=July 2022}}</ref> where they can be compared, as the US Census Data refers to modern national borders instead of 1989 borders. Similar remarks apply to 1990 estimates in the [[List of countries by past and future population]] which also only apply to modern-day national borders. See also [[Soviet Census (1989)]] and [[1990 United States census]] for comparison.
